latest.title: Prescribed-Time Control Barrier Functions for Safety-Critical Systems
latest.abstract: This paper presents a prescribed-time control barrier function approach for ensuring safety of dynamical systems within a user-specified time horizon.

latest.title: Adaptive Robust CBF for Uncertain Robotic Systems
latest.abstract: We propose an adaptive robust control barrier function framework for robotic systems with parametric uncertainties and external disturbances.

latest.title: Event-Triggered CBF for Multi-Agent Systems
latest.abstract: This work develops an event-triggered control barrier function framework for distributed safety in multi-agent systems.

latest.title: Learning-Based CBF with Neural Network Approximations
latest.abstract: We propose a learning-based approach to construct control barrier functions using neural network approximations for high-dimensional systems.

latest.title: High-Order CBF for Fixed-Time Safety Guarantees
latest.abstract: A high-order control barrier function framework providing fixed-time safety guarantees for nonlinear control systems.
latest.venue: IEEE Conference on Decision and Control

high_cited.title: Control Barrier Functions: Theory and Applications
high_cited.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive introduction to control barrier functions (CBFs) and their applications in safety-critical control systems.

high_cited.title: Safety-Critical Model Predictive Control with Control Barrier Functions
high_cited.abstract: A framework combining model predictive control with control barrier functions for safety-critical applications.
